basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old avid fan of Japanese tokusatsu series, particularly Kamen Rider. Originally from Seattle, I'm currently working as a software developer for a tech startup. My interests include watching anime, exploring new music genres, and experimenting with different keto recipes. I recently became a father, which has been an exciting yet challenging journey. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings after my daughter is asleep. Married to a wonderful partner who shares my love for Clairo's music.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of Kamen Rider series, stemming from years of watching and discussing it with fellow fans. My technical skills in software development are self-taught, aided by online courses and community forums. Recently, I've developed an interest in keto lifestyle, learning through blogs and recipe-sharing platforms.
